description: List all channels in a server, grouped by their parent category and ordered by position. Returns a JSON object keyed by category name. Channels that Discord hides from the bot behind the placeholder name ___hidden___ are left out, and discord_find_channel_by_name reports how many; a visible channel whose category is hidden is listed under "Hidden parent". Read-only. Use discord_find_channel_by_name to locate a specific channel.
name: discord_list_channels
